name: openclaw-release-radar
description: Release stability monitor for openclaw/openclaw — polls GitHub issues, scores releases via LLM.

scripts.verify:scripts: for f in scripts/*.mjs scripts/lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.verify:ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:scripts && npm run build
scripts.verify:local: npm run doctor -- --fail-on-warnings && npm run verify:score -- --all && npm run verify:release-audit -- --all
scripts.verify:live: npm run doctor -- --fail-on-warnings --api-base http://127.0.0.1:8787 && npm run verify:score -- --all && npm run verify:release-audit -- --all --api-base http://127.0.0.1:8787 && npm run ui:smoke
